Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Theft Claim

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed our review of your claim regarding the theft of your vehicle. At this time, your claim is denied.

This decision was reached because your policy provides liability coverage only and does not cover damage to or theft of your own vehicle. Specifically, policy clause [LIAB-2] states: "This policy provides liability coverage only."

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

If you have any questions, please contact us.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
